module_summary: AXI memory-to-stream DMA: AXI-lite registers program address/length, a busy controller issues AXI read bursts sized by FIFO space, and returned data flows through a FIFO to AXI-Stream.

anchors.name: r_busy
anchors.why: Idle/busy controller state; gates command writes, burst issue, counters and completion.

anchors.name: cmd_addr
anchors.why: Programmed transfer start address; loads AR address and is updated in continuous mode.

anchors.name: cmd_length_w
anchors.why: Programmed transfer length in words, written via LENLO/LENHI registers.

anchors.name: r_increment
anchors.why: Control bit selecting incrementing versus fixed-address bursts.

anchors.name: r_continuous
anchors.why: Continuous-mode control bit; keeps FIFO and address across commands.

anchors.name: w_cmd_start
anchors.why: Decoded start request from control-register write; sets r_busy.

anchors.name: cmd_abort
anchors.why: Registered software abort (ABORT_KEY write); clears remaining requests and blocks bursts.

anchors.name: axi_abort_pending
anchors.why: Abort in progress after error response or cmd abort; stops bursts and address increment.

anchors.name: w_complete
anchors.why: Completion condition ending busy, setting complete flag and interrupt.

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Error status bit set on AXI error response or bad unaligned command.

anchors.name: r_complete
anchors.why: Completion status bit in status word, cleared by control writes.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt output pulsed when a busy transfer completes.

anchors.name: zero_length
anchors.why: Flags zero programmed length; blocks command start.

anchors.name: unaligned_cmd_addr
anchors.why: Unaligned address flag; only active with OPT_UNALIGNED.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI read-address request valid driven from axi_arvalid.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: AR channel ready; advances address/length and arvalid.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: AXI read burst address from axi_araddr register.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Burst length output; also updates remaining and uncommitted counts.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid; writes FIFO and decrements read counters.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data from memory written into the stream FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RLAST
anchors.why: Last beat of burst; decrements outstanding-burst count.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Read response; error bit sets r_err and abort pending.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Stream output valid whenever FIFO is non-empty.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Stream ready; pops FIFO and frees uncommitted space.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Stream data read out of the FIFO.

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag; drives TVALID and non-continuous completion.

anchors.name: write_to_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO push enable from accepted read beats.

anchors.name: read_from_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO pop enable on stream handshake.

anchors.name: ar_requests_remaining
anchors.why: Words still to be requested on AR channel, reduced per burst.

anchors.name: ar_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Bursts issued but not yet finished with RLAST.

anchors.name: rd_reads_remaining
anchors.why: Read beats still expected; drives completion detection.

anchors.name: rd_uncommitted
anchors.why: Uncommitted FIFO space; bursts start only when enough room exists.

anchors.name: r_max_burst
anchors.why: Length of next burst, limited by alignment and remaining words.

anchors.name: initial_burstlen
anchors.why: First burst length from alignment, mode and command length.

anchors.name: phantom_start
anchors.why: Registered burst-issued pulse updating remaining, outstanding and FIFO-space counters.

anchors.name: start_burst
anchors.why: Decision to issue next AR burst; loads axi_arvalid.

anchors.name: axi_raddr
anchors.why: Tracks current read-data address, incremented per accepted beat.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write accept enabling register updates and BVALID.

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite read accept setting read valid.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Register index selecting which control register a write updates.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI-lite write data programming control, address and length registers.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_AWADDR
anchors.why: AXI-lite write register address into skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI-lite readback of status word, address and length.

anchors.name: w_status_word
anchors.why: Status word packing busy, err, complete, continuous, increment bits.

groups.name: AXI-lite register bank
groups.description: Skid-buffered AXI-lite slave writing address, length, control registers and reading back status.

groups.name: Command controller
groups.description: Busy/idle control: start, abort, error, completion and interrupt generation.

groups.name: AR burst generator
groups.description: Computes burst lengths/addresses and issues AXI read requests when FIFO space allows.

groups.name: Read return tracking
groups.description: Counts returned read beats and tracks read address for completion and restart.

groups.name: Stream data FIFO
groups.description: FIFO buffering read data toward AXI-Stream with uncommitted-space accounting.
